::: {.callout-note} Welcome, students! This specialized section contains syllabus breakdowns, core study notes, targeted practice question banks, and actual exam past papers organized dynamically to optimize your learning and help you achieve an A* (Grade 9). ::: ## 1. Course Introduction

CIE IGCSE Chemistry (Syllabus Code: 0620) provides students with a detailed and comprehensive understanding of the technological world in which they live, and an informed interest in science and scientific developments. Students learn about the basic principles of chemistry through a mix of theoretical study and practical investigations, developing essential skills for further academic pathways (such as A-Level or IB DP Chemistry).

### Assessment Outline

The CIE IGCSE Chemistry 0620 course is assessed through three papers. Candidates who have studied the Core syllabus content are entered for Paper 1, Paper 3 and either Paper 5 or Paper 6. Candidates who have studied the Extended syllabus content (Core and Supplement) are entered for Paper 2, Paper 4 and either Paper 5 or Paper 6.

Assessment Paper Target Curriculum Format & Duration Marks Weighting
Paper 1 (Multiple Choice) Core 40 multiple-choice questions — 45 minutes 40 marks 30%
Paper 2 (Multiple Choice) Extended 40 multiple-choice questions — 45 minutes 40 marks 30%
Paper 3 (Theory) Core Short-answer and structured questions — 75 minutes 80 marks 50%
Paper 4 (Theory) Extended Short-answer and structured questions — 75 minutes 80 marks 50%
Paper 5 (Practical Test) Core & Extended Laboratory-based practical tasks — 75 minutes 40 marks 20%
Paper 6 (Alternative to Practical) Core & Extended Written questions on experimental skills — 60 minutes 40 marks 20%
### Syllabus Structure

The syllabus content is divided into 13 key areas, including core concepts and experimental skills:

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"} ## Topic 1: State of Matter **1.1**: Solids, liquids and gases
**1.2**: Diffusion ::: ::: {.callout-note collapse="true"} ## Topic 2: Atom, Elements and Compounds **2.1**: Elements, compounds and mixtures
**2.2**: Atomic structure and the Periodic Table
**2.3**: Isotopes
**2.4**: Ions and ionic bonds
**2.5**: Simple molecules and covalent bonds
**2.6**: Giant covalent structures
**2.7**: Metallic bonding ::: ::: {.callout-note collapse="true"} ## Topic 3: Stoichiometry **3.1**: Formulae
**3.2**: Relative masses of atoms and molecules
**3.3**: The mole and the Avogadro constant ::: ::: {.callout-note collapse="true"} ## Topic 4: Electrochemistry **4.1**: Electrolysis
**4.2**: Hydrogen–oxygen fuel cells ::: ::: {.callout-note collapse="true"} ## Topic 5: Chemical Energetics **5.1**: Exothermic and endothermic reactions ::: ::: {.callout-note collapse="true"} ## Topic 6: Chemical Reactions **6.1**: Physical and chemical changes
**6.2**: Rate of reaction
**6.3**: Reversible reactions and equilibrium
**6.4**: Redox ::: ::: {.callout-note collapse="true"} ## Topic 7: Acids, Bases and Salts **7.1**: The characteristic properties of acids and bases
**7.2**: Oxides
**7.3**: Preparation of salts ::: ::: {.callout-note collapse="true"} ## Topic 8: Periodic Table **8.1**: Arrangement of elements
**8.2**: Group I properties
**8.3**: Group VII properties
**8.4**: Transition elements
**8.5**: Noble gases ::: ::: {.callout-note collapse="true"} ## Topic 9: Metals **9.1**: Properties of metals
**9.2**: Uses of metals
**9.3**: Alloys and their properties
**9.4**: Reactivity series
**9.5**: Corrosion of metals
**9.6**: Extraction of metals ::: ::: {.callout-note collapse="true"} ## Topic 10: Chemistry of the Environment **10.1**: Water
**10.2**: Fertilisers
**10.3**: Air quality and climate ::: ::: {.callout-note collapse="true"} ## Topic 11: Organic Chemistry **11.1**: Formulae, functional groups and terminology
**11.2**: Naming organic compounds
**11.3**: Fuels
**11.4**: Alkanes
**11.5**: Alkenes
**11.6**: Alcohols
**11.7**: Carboxylic acids
**11.8**: Polymers ::: ::: {.callout-note collapse="true"} ## Topic 12: Experimental Techniques **12.1**: Experimental design
**12.2**: Acid–base titrations
**12.3**: Chromatography
**12.4**: Separation and purification
**12.5**: Identification of ions and gases ::: ::: {.callout-note collapse="true"} ## Topic 13: Practical Skills **Practical 1**: Techniques, Apparatus and Materials
**Practical 2**: Plan Experiments and Investigations
**Practical 3**: Observations, Measurements and Estimates
**Practical 4**: Evaluate Observations and Data
**Practical 5**: Evaluate Methods and Improvements ::: ::: {.download-box} ### Official Academic Resources *Download official CIE resources and syllabus guides below (Google Drive links will be loaded from local files):*
